target.title: fix(fal): route grok-imagine and nano-banana-2-lite edits to correct endpoints
target.body:
<!-- Title: fix(fal): route grok-imagine and nano-banana-2-lite edits to correct endpoints -->

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where `image_generate` calls with reference images fail with `HTTP 404 Path /image-to-image not found` for two fal-hosted models:

- `xai/grok-imagine-image` — Grok Imagine
- `google/nano-banana-2-lite` — Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image

The fal provider unconditionally appends `/image-to-image` to any model that isn't `openai/gpt-image-*` or `fal-ai/nano-banana-*` when reference images are supplied. Both models above serve their edit surface at a different URL:

| Model | Correct edit endpoint | What we send today |
|---|---|---|
| `xai/grok-imagine-image` | `/quality/edit` | `/image-to-image` → 404 |
| `google/nano-banana-2-lite` | `/edit` | `/image-to-image` → 404 |

Grok additionally expects lowercase resolution enum values (`1k`/`2k` only) and a distinct aspect_ratio enum; `nano-banana-2-lite` does not accept a `resolution` parameter at all.

## Why This Change Was Made

Add schema entries for both models so `ensureFalModelPath` and `applyFalImageGeometry` pick the right endpoint suffix and body shape.

- Extend `FalImageModelSchema` with two optional fields: `resolutions?: readonly ("1K" | "2K" | "4K")[]` (allowlist + opt-out via `[]`) and `resolutionCase?: "lower"` (wire-level lowercasing for Grok).
- Widen `appendEditPath` to include `"quality/edit"` for Grok.
- Refactor `ensureFalModelPath` to consult `schema.appendEditPath` instead of hardcoded model-prefix checks, so future model additions only need a schema entry.

Existing behaviour is preserved for `fal-ai/flux/*` (image-to-image), `openai/gpt-image-*` (edit), `fal-ai/nano-banana-*` (edit, uppercase resolution forwarded), and `krea/v2/*` (no edit suffix).

Out of scope: no changes to the flux/gpt-image/nb2 request bodies; no refactor of unrelated helpers.

## User Impact

Users can now call `image_generate` with a reference image against `xai/grok-imagine-image` and `google/nano-banana-2-lite`. Before this fix, both routes always failed with HTTP 404 from fal. Text-to-image calls to the same models were unaffected and remain unaffected.

## Evidence

**Live fal.ai calls** (real API, from a local runner):

```
→ Grok Imagine Quality Edit (xai/grok-imagine-image/quality/edit)
  POST fal.run/xai/grok-imagine-image/quality/edit
  status=200 took=12535ms  ✅

→ Nano Banana 2 Lite Edit (google/nano-banana-2-lite/edit)
  POST fal.run/google/nano-banana-2-lite/edit
  status=200 took=4509ms  ✅

→ CONTROL: buggy old URL (xai/grok-imagine-image/image-to-image)
  status=404 took=338ms  ❌ (reproduces the bug)

→ CONTROL: buggy old URL (google/nano-banana-2-lite/image-to-image)
  status=404 took=234ms  ❌ (reproduces the bug)
```

**Unit tests** — 9 new tests added, all passing:

```
extensions/fal/image-generation-provider.test.ts (34 tests) 72ms
- routes Nano Banana 2 Lite edits through /edit with image_urls
- rejects Krea-only aspect ratios for Nano Banana 2 Lite
- rejects resolution overrides for Nano Banana 2 Lite edits
- rejects Nano Banana 2 Lite edits above 14 reference images
- routes Grok Imagine edits through /quality/edit with lowercase resolution
- rejects 4K resolution for Grok Imagine edits
- rejects Nano Banana ratios for Grok Imagine
- rejects Grok Imagine edits above 3 reference images
- preserves an explicit Grok Imagine /quality/edit model path

Test Files  3 passed (3)
     Tests  58 passed (58)
```

Full fal extension suite (image + music + video) is 58/58 green. `pnpm tsgo:test` is clean. `pnpm lint` (oxlint) reports 0 warnings and 0 errors across core, extensions, and scripts.

**Endpoint specs cross-checked against fal.ai schema docs:**

- https://fal.ai/models/xai/grok-imagine-image/quality/edit/api
- https://fal.ai/models/google/nano-banana-2-lite/edit/api
- https://fal.ai/models/fal-ai/nano-banana-2/edit/api (existing schema this piggybacks on)

## AI-assistance

This change was drafted with an LLM coding agent (Claude). A second reviewer model (Claude Sonnet) cross-checked the patch against the fal schemas and flagged one bug — that `google/nano-banana-2-lite` would silently forward a `resolution` field to an endpoint that doesn't accept it — which is fixed in the final version via `resolutions: []` opt-out and a corresponding rejection test.
